title: Live official-source contract refresh and fail-closed candidate readiness
source_upgrades: HMLR July 2026 publication and monthly schedule live revalidated
EA persistent DTM 1m WCS 2.0.1 endpoint and NoData contract live revalidated
OS Terrain 50 exact 2,858-tile / 55-folder national supply contract live revalidated
checks: INSPIRE download page states the current dataset was published on 5 July 2026.
New files are published on the first Sunday of each month.
The dataset information page states each publication represents the previous month.
Downloads are divided by local authority.
A polygon on a local-authority boundary may appear in both authority files.
The official dataset is published as GML files.
The dataset shows the indicative extent and position of registered freehold properties.
The official catalogue describes England and Wales coverage.
The official catalogue identifies the Open Government Licence.
The download page states GIS software is required to view the GML polygons.
Technical guidance states the data is captured against British National Grid.
Official guidance warns BNG-to-WGS84 conversion may shift features by up to 15 metres.
Defra publishes the persistent DTM 1m WCS endpoint without a year suffix.
The published GetCapabilities example uses WCS version 2.0.1.
The source is the LIDAR Composite Digital Terrain Model at 1 m resolution.
The official dataset metadata identifies EPSG:27700.
The official dataset describes approximately 99% coverage of England.
Defra states WCS supplies raw pixel data such as elevation.
The official FAQ gives the GeoTIFF NoData value as -3.4028235e+38.
The official dataset states vertical accuracy of +/-15 cm RMSE.
The published composite metadata covers surveys from 6 June 2000 to 2 April 2022.
Defra replaced retired Esri Image Services with WCS/WMS services.
The dataset page identifies the Environment Agency as publisher.
The exact DTM 1m WCS GetCapabilities route is published by Defra.
OS Terrain 50 is documented as an open height dataset and DTM.
The grid product has regular 50 m post spacing.
The contour product uses 10 m contour intervals.
Grid and contour data are supplied as 10 km by 10 km tiles.
The national supply is documented as exactly 2,858 tiles.
The 2,858 tiles are arranged into 55 100 km grid-square folders.
The product documentation states annual July updates.
OS Terrain 50 is an OpenData product free for commercial, educational and personal use.
The product supply page states online download is available without registration.
The grid is available in ASCII and GML 3.2.1.
Contours are available in GML, Shapefile, GeoPackage and vector tiles.
OS Downloads API supports OpenData product discovery and automated download.
HMLR is retained for parcel polygons, EA DTM for primary elevation, and OS Terrain 50 for cross-check.
No height value is derived from HMLR polygon attributes.
Only EA WCS raw elevation pixels are eligible as the primary numeric source.
OS Terrain 50 remains an independent terrain cross-check rather than a parcel identity source.
HMLR and EA official guidance both identify British National Grid / EPSG:27700.
No nearest-polygon or inferred identity fill is authorized.
Generic UPRN/title/identifier fields remain ineligible for HMLR exact-ID promotion.
The three official source families remain publicly discoverable; no paid source is required for this recovery increment.
Rows 61523, 61524 and 61525 remain the only verified numeric examples.
Rows 61540-61551 remain candidate-only until exact identity, WCS sampling and remote seals complete.
This increment performs live official-source contract verification only; execution-host runtime is not simulated.
All 22 expected runtime outputs remain required; no synthetic or inferred numeric output was created.
